Use your recovery phrase to keep control of your username, @%1$s. If someone else ever takes over your username, or %2$s can no longer manage it, your recovery phrase lets you take it back.
For now, this works only while %1$s is running, because that’s the only place your username is recorded. Your recovery phrase never leaves this device.
Anyone with your recovery phrase can take your username. Keep it somewhere safe and private.
